_note: The TAC BOARD in the cockpit: cruise, then a missile shot, with the pilot's [TacBoard] options set for the run only (environment.config, put back afterwards; the keys must already be in com.marci.boscalisummer.cfg, so launch the game once with this build first). One look per run, chosen by variables: the default run is WIDE at scale 1, shade 0.45, board on; --set look=stack --set layout=Stack | --set look=scale07 --set scale=0.7 | --set look=shade0 --set shade=0 | --set look=off --set enabled=false. The off run shows the game's own weapon, countermeasure and power panels; the default run is the board on again. The captures are named cruise-<look>, shot-<look>, shot-later-<look> and after-<look>; dock/fire/msl in results.json are the geometry and tracker probes. Nothing here asserts the board itself: the evidence is the screenshots (a live off-then-on within one run needs a HudAutomation config hook).
name: tac-board
description: TAC BOARD looks in the cockpit: wide, stack, scale 0.7, shade 0, board off.
